verdict.rationale: A work-management tool could plausibly generate per-release changelogs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no first-party changelog or release-notes generation feature. What it does show are developer building blocks (an API tutorial for building a status-update report app, webhooks), generic MCP 'reports and summaries' via external AI clients, and GitHub PR status sync. None of these is a documented capability that auto-generates a changelog for each release.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can auto-generate a changelog for each release so shipping progress is easy to review
